other_conditions: Minimum education of 12th Pass/ITI/Diploma/Graduation/Post Graduation is required.
Candidate must be registered with Aadhaar.
Bank account must be linked with Aadhaar.
benefits_summary: Stipend ranging from ₹6,000 to ₹10,000 depending on educational qualification, transferred directly to Aadhaar‑linked bank accounts.
